summary: Retested the 5 fixes from iteration_325 and ran a quick regression. Backend: 17 of 18 pytest pass (7 new iter326 tests plus the 11 iter325 regression tests). (1) The lazy migration now upserts: 12 concurrent GET /payment-settings calls for the main project left exactly 1 migrated doc. (2) GET /delivery-apps in the all-projects view returns one row per (app, project) assignment: toters general 15% and toters for صالون الأناقة 17%, each with its project_name, and no duplicate keys. Editing commission or deleting a project row changes only that assignment (API and UI). (3) PUT /users/{id} with only branch_id set to a branch of another project syncs project_id to P_BURGER. Sending a mismatched branch and project explicitly still returns 400. (4) The POST /auth/login user object no longer contains password_vault, but GET /auth/me still returns it (the one failing test). (5) Stale-response guard: I delayed project A's /tenant/invoice-settings response by 5s with page.route, switched A then B quickly, and the field showed B's value (PHONE-BBB). Regression passed in the UI: delivery-app-row/edit/delete testids on each assignment, the edit dialog prefilled with the salon project, choose-project-notice on the Payment and Callcenter tabs plus its chip selection, the users list filtered to the salon project, and the iter325 non-enterprise pytest tests.

minor.issue: The response still includes password_vault (the encrypted plain password). get_me only deletes 'password'. Add user.pop('password_vault', None) and user.pop('password_hash', None). The frontend has no reference to password_vault, so removing it is safe.
Moving an assignment (e.g. toters general) to a project that already has its own toters doc deletes the source and silently overwrites the target project's commission. There is no conflict warning.
The branch lookup is not tenant-scoped (db.branches.find_one({'id': branch_id})). This is low risk but should filter by tenant_id.

issues: The role badge for project_admin shows the raw key 'project_admin' in low-contrast grey. getRoleText has no mapping for it.
The per-row commission Input has no data-testid. Its onBlur also fires a POST and a fetchData even when the value did not change.

action_items: Strip password_vault (and password_hash) from the GET /api/auth/me response.
Optional: map project_admin in getRoleText and add a data-testid to the delivery commission input.
Optional: warn or block when moving a delivery assignment onto a project that already has that app.
critical_code_review_comments: The stale guard compares localStorage selectedProjectId before and after the await. This is fine, but on a stale return the finally block in fetchInvoiceSettings still runs setInvoiceLoading(false) while the newer request is pending. This is cosmetic only.
server.py (18.7k lines) and Settings.js (8.2k lines) are still far over the size guidelines.

success_rate.backend: 94% (17/18; the only failure is password_vault in /auth/me)

seed_data_creation: None kept. Temp test_it326 users and delivery apps were removed, the toters salon commission was set back to 17, and the temp invoice docs for P_A/P_B (tmp326) were deleted. The main-project payment_settings migrated doc was restored from a snapshot.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For UI login, POST /api/auth/login with device_id e2e-tester-persistent, inject the token and cached_user into localStorage, then wait 14s. To test the stale guard, use page.route('**/api/tenant/invoice-settings**') and delay requests with header x-project-id == P_A. Delivery rows are keyed delivery-app-row-{app}-{project_id|all}. Run pytest with the backend .env exported plus REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
